{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk chiffon midi dress, A-line silhouette falling to mid-calf, blush pink #FFD1DC, fluid woven fabric.
Strappy suede sandals, kitten heel height, nude #E3C7BE, smooth leather upper.
Pearl drop earrings, classic round studs, white mother-of-pearl #F0F8FF, lightweight metal setting.

This outfit perfectly balances the transition from an afternoon garden gathering to an evening restaurant dinner in August, as the breathable silk and modest midi length respect the summer heat while maintaining wedding-appropriate elegance. The blush pink hue complements outdoor lighting and photographs beautifully against greenery, whereas the nude sandals elongate the legs for a polished silhouette suitable for both standing on grass and dining indoors. Minimal pearl jewelry adds a touch of refined sparkle without overwhelming the dress code, ensuring you look celebratory yet comfortable throughout the entire reception."}
